setup: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your arms at your sides or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto the working leg while unlocking that knee slightly.
Brace your core and fix your gaze on a point on the floor a few feet ahead for balance.
steps: Hinge at your hips to push your pelvis back while reaching your non-working leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso toward the floor in a straight line with the back leg until you feel a deep stretch in the standing hamstring.
Keep your hips square to the ground, avoiding any rotation of the pelvis.
Drive through the midfoot and heel of the standing leg, extending the hip to return to the upright starting position.
Finish all prescribed repetitions on one leg before switching to the opposite side.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you hinge forward and lengthen the hamstring; exhale as you extend the hip and return to the top.
cues: Reach your back heel toward the wall.
Keep your belt buckle pointed straight at the floor.

common_faults.fault: Opening or rotating the non-working hip upward toward the ceiling.
common_faults.correction: Point the toes of your floating foot straight down to keep your pelvis level and square.

common_faults.fault: Rounding the spine to reach toward the floor rather than hinging at the hip.
common_faults.correction: Maintain a flat back and proud chest; stop hinging as soon as your hamstring reaches end range.

common_faults.fault: Locking the standing knee completely out or letting it cave inward.
common_faults.correction: Maintain a soft knee bend and distribute weight evenly across the tripod of your standing foot.

precautions: Position yourself near a wall or sturdy support to lightly touch for balance if needed.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
summary: A unilateral hip-hinge exercise performed on one leg to develop hamstring strength, glute activation, and single-leg balance.
